mainEntity.name: What is Seedream 5.5, and what can I create?

acceptedAnswer.text: Seedream 5.5 is an AI image generation and editing model developed by ByteDance. On MaxVideoAI, use text or up to 10 reference images to create portraits, cinematic scenes, campaign images and transparent PNG assets. Each request returns one still image.

mainEntity.name: How is Seedream 5.5 different from Seedream 5.0 Pro?

acceptedAnswer.text: ByteDance presents 5.5 as an advance in successive edits, realism and text rendering, with native transparent PNG output. In MaxVideoAI, 5.5 also offers 1K, 1.5K and 2K instead of Pro’s 2K-only output. Both accept up to 10 references and return one image per request. The examples above show selected results, not a controlled head-to-head benchmark.

mainEntity.name: How do I refine the same scene?

acceptedAnswer.text: Use the selected image as a reference. State what to preserve and ask for a focused change, then inspect the new result before using it for the next edit.

mainEntity.name: Can I create a transparent background?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. Choose PNG output and the transparent-background setting. JPEG is suitable for an opaque scene.

mainEntity.name: Which resolutions and formats are available?

acceptedAnswer.text: MaxVideoAI offers 1K, 1.5K and 2K, with JPEG or PNG output. Image editing accepts up to 10 references and returns one image; use Lite when you need image sets.

mainEntity.name: Can I animate the image afterwards?

acceptedAnswer.text: Save the still and choose a video model for a separate generation. A readable silhouette, clear hands and space around the subject make the opening frame easier to plan.

mainEntity.name: How much does Seedream 5.5 cost on MaxVideoAI?

acceptedAnswer.text: MaxVideoAI uses pay-as-you-go credits, with no required subscription. Choose your resolution and references in Create, then review the current price before generating. Each new generation or edit has its own quote.

mainEntity.name: What is Seedance 2.5 Flash?

acceptedAnswer.text: Seedance 2.5 Flash is ByteDance’s AI video generation model for creating clips from text, images and multimodal references. This MaxVideoAI workflow offers 480p or 720p output, 4–30 second generation and optional audio, with separate Create, Modify and Extend actions.

mainEntity.name: How do I create a Seedance 2.5 Flash video?

acceptedAnswer.text: Open Create with Flash and describe the scene, action, camera and sound. Add a first frame, an optional end frame or supported references for the workflow you choose. Select the output settings, review the price and generate. Use Modify or Extend when you want to work from an existing video.

mainEntity.name: What image, video and audio references can I use?

acceptedAnswer.text: Flash accepts up to 10 images, 5 videos and 5 audio clips, subject to the selected mode. Images can guide the subject or setting; videos can guide movement and framing; audio can guide the sound. Reference videos share a 30-second total limit, and audio references require a visual input.

mainEntity.name: Can Seedance 2.5 Flash generate sound?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. Enable generated audio and describe dialogue, ambience or sound effects alongside the action. Audio references guide the request; they are different from enabling audio output. Review timing and intelligibility in the generated result.

mainEntity.name: What is the difference between Modify and Extend?

acceptedAnswer.text: Modify asks for a change inside a source video and follows its aspect ratio and approximate duration. Extend asks for a continuation before or after a source clip. Choose the source excerpt and describe the change or continuation explicitly; check movement, identity and sound in the result.

mainEntity.name: How is Flash different from standard Seedance 2.5?

acceptedAnswer.text: In MaxVideoAI, Flash offers 480p or 720p. Standard Seedance 2.5 also offers 1080p and a native Draft-to-final workflow with different reference limits. A normal Flash generation is not a finalizable Draft. Compare the settings and current quotes for the version you need.

mainEntity.name: How much does Seedance 2.5 Flash cost?

acceptedAnswer.text: The price depends on the selected duration, resolution, audio and source inputs. Reference videos can affect billable duration. Review the exact quote in Create before each generation or edit; the pricing page gives the broader comparison.

mainEntity.name: Can Milo help me write the video prompt?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. Milo is the AI assistant inside the Create prompt editor. Explain the scene in your own words, discuss the action, camera or sound, then review and apply the suggested prompt. You choose the generation settings and confirm the displayed price.

mainEntity.name: Which examples are real Seedance 2.5 Flash videos?

acceptedAnswer.text: The drummer, ballet source/result, wardrobe source/edit, diner dialogue and orbital scene were generated with Seedance 2.5 Flash. The red-coat character reference was made with Seedream 5.5. Extend remains an illustrated timeline; the hero and gallery preview are still images. Each real demonstration includes its submitted prompt. Reference acceptance and output quality can vary.

She asks about a missed train. A hand stills on a coffee cup. His answer changes the mood. Unequal shot lengths follow the question, admission and invitation to stay.

Write the turning point, gestures and reactions in story order.
The camera
Choose framing and cuts for each beat. Timing follows the story, not equal divisions.

mainEntity.name: How is Seedream 5.0 Pro different from Lite, Flash and 5.5?

acceptedAnswer.text: Pro is a single-image 2K route for detailed portraits, campaign layouts and infographics. Lite supports image sets; Flash is the fast 5.0 variant; 5.5 adds a native transparent PNG option alongside its image generation and editing workflow.

mainEntity.name: Can I use several reference images?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. Use up to 10 references to guide one generated image. Assign each image a role, such as the person, wardrobe, location or visual style.

mainEntity.name: Can Pro create text and infographics?

acceptedAnswer.text: You can request exact wording, multilingual labels and a clear layout. Review every letter and verify the information in the finished image before publishing.

mainEntity.name: Does Pro support batch output?

acceptedAnswer.text: MaxVideoAI returns one 2K image per request with JPEG or PNG output. Choose Seedream 5.0 Lite for related image sets.

mainEntity.name: How do I prepare a still for animation?

acceptedAnswer.text: Choose a readable pose, clear face and hands, and space around the subject. Save the selected still and plan the motion in a separate video model. The video generation has its own settings and quote.
